data.title: Verdict: AcmeDB Steps Into the Ring
data.subject: AcmeDB
data.take: the boring database that actually ships, and boring is the whole pitch
data.summary: AcmeDB does one thing, durable key-value storage, and it does that without an operator PhD. No consensus wizardry. No sharding astrology. Just a WAL, a manifest, and docs that answer the question you actually asked.

receipts.evidence: vendor benchmark on a laptop, not replicated
the docs list snapshots as 'coming soon'

data.bottom_line: Ship it behind a cache, sure. Your crown jewels stay the hell out of it.
caveats: We did not run our own benchmark. The latency number is theirs, not ours.
Checked against the docs on the date above. Roadmaps move.
